mechanism: Copy a crossed-out roster name as volunteering, then set a night-shift loyalty test that reveals A's unwillingness to lose sleep when the mark is corrected.
confusable: Not honest inability to work: A must confidently cover the misunderstood mark and impose a test whose reciprocal version A resists.
comparison: Project staffing and sleep rather than comfort in prize seating.
seedUse: Retains overnight commitment test and leadership excuse; replaces final self-analysis with a request that exposes reluctance.
